The agency's overview page words the same date as 'within 30 days after the end of the quarter'.

efile.text: Every employer who withholds, or is required to withhold, Louisiana income tax must file a quarterly withholding tax return electronically for every assigned filing period. Payments must be submitted electronically according to your assigned payment frequency.

returns.name: Form L-1, Louisiana Withholding Tax Return (quarterly)
contents: One return per quarter, filed electronically even if nothing was withheld (zero return); due the last day of the month after the quarter for quarterly and monthly payers, the 15th of the month after the quarter for semi-monthly payers.
Reports the month-by-month withholding and the payments made for the quarter.

returns.name: Form L-3, Annual Withholding Reconciliation
contents: Filed electronically (LaWage may be used) by January 31 after the year, or 30 days after final wages if the business closes.
The quarterly return is Form L-1; it is required even for zero returns, with the month-by-month amounts and payments for the quarter.

notModelled: Semi-monthly payers' L-1 is due the 15th after the quarter; the profile records the quarterly/monthly date for the return entry (the payment rules above carry both).

deposits.interpretation: Louisiana assigns the payment frequency from the average monthly withholding: under $500 QUARTERLY, $500 to under $5,000 MONTHLY, $5,000 or more SEMI-MONTHLY. Payments are made electronically. QUARTERLY payments are due the last day of the month after the quarter; MONTHLY payments the last day of the month following the month; SEMI-MONTHLY payments for the 1st-15th are due by the end of the same month and for the 16th-end by the 15th of the following month. The quarterly return Form L-1 is due the last day of the month after the quarter (April 30, July 31, October 31, January 31) for quarterly and monthly payers and the 15th of the month after the quarter (April 15, July 15, October 15, January 15) for semi-monthly payers, with a zero return when nothing was withheld. The Department's calendar showed February 2, 2026 for the fourth-quarter return because January 31 was a Saturday, so weekends roll to the next business day. The frequency is an INPUT or is derived from the average monthly amount supplied.

returns.name: Employer's Quarterly Wage & Tax Report
contents: Filed online and any tax remitted no later than April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31 (the last day of the month after the quarter); interest of 1 percent a month and a penalty capped at 25 percent begin the day after the due date (R.S. 23:1543(A)).

notModelled: The Commission's overview page says 'within 30 days after the end of the quarter'; the 2025 guide prints the last-day-of-month dates and those are modelled.
The domestic employer annual report (due January 31) and the other penalties in R.S. 23:1538 are recorded as text only.
